note: Careless violence (brief 059 S1; Motive's s1-rulings careless-thin-all), the twin of route-b: the Enforcer sets out to take down all three posted rivals on the square before the pickup. The lone one by the café terrace goes down unseen (as route-b-thin), but the pair on its east side cannot be thinned quietly (M059-S1.6): rival-2 sees rival-1 taken down and draws, the Enforcer shoots him, and the run is loud from then on (the shots traced, Alert 2 when the bodies are found), so the yard fight is the police from the official entrance; the car goes once their blocker is down, leaving the Scout and Fixer behind.
